question: Скільки днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік я маю?
answer: Скільки часу ви вже працюєте в компанії (з якої дати ваш стаж)?
expected_answer: Відпустка рахується в годинах: 80 годин (0–3 роки стажу), 120 (3–5 років), 160 (5+ років); part-time — 40 годин.

question: Скільки днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік я маю?
answer: Згідно з довідником, працівники мають 24 календарні дні оплачуваної щорічної відпустки після 6 місяців безперервної роботи. Протягом перших 6 місяців відпустка нараховується пропорційно тривалості роботи. Для офісу в Україні відпустка нараховується за календарним роком, а з 1 січня знову становить 24 календарні дні. Щоб отримати відпустку раніше, є винятки для окремих категорій, наприклад, жінок до і після пологів, осіб з інвалідністю, працівників, які щойно після військової служби, тощо.
expected_answer: 24 календарні дні після 6 місяців безперервної роботи; до того — пропорційно відпрацьованому часу.

question: Скільки днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік я маю?
answer: Згідно з довідником, за Costa Rica ви маєте 18 календарних днів оплачуваної щорічної відпустки після щонайменше 50 тижнів безперервної роботи. До завершення 50 тижнів відпустка нараховується пропорційно тривалості роботи. Деякі категорії працівників (зокрема вагітні та жінки після пологів, особи з інвалідністю, ті, хто нещодавно пройшов військову службу, і студенти для складання іспитів) можуть отримати повну відпустку раніше. Для відпустки потрібно повідомити керівника за два тижні.
expected_answer: 18 календарних днів після 50 тижнів безперервної роботи; до того — пропорційно відпрацьованому часу.

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: You become eligible to use paid vacation time after 60 days of employment. Vacation hours are front-loaded on your anniversary date: full-time employees get 80 hours in their first 0-3 years, and part-time employees get 40 hours.
expected_answer: New employees can use vacation after 60 days of employment.

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: You become entitled to the full 24 calendar days of paid annual leave after completing at least 6 months of continuous employment. During your first 6 months, you accrue vacation pro-rated for the length of your employment. Some categories of employees get full-duration leave before the 6-month mark, including female employees before and after pregnancy and childbirth, employees with two or more children under 15 or a child with a disability, employees with disabilities, employees whose wives are on maternity leave, employees hired after military service, and students who want leave for exams or a thesis.
expected_answer: The full 24 days after 6 months of continuous employment; before that a pro-rated vacation (some categories get the full leave earlier).

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: In Costa Rica, you are entitled to 18 calendar days of paid annual leave after completing at least 50 weeks of continuous employment. During your first 50 weeks, you accrue a vacation pro-rated for the time you have worked. Some categories get full-duration annual leave before the 50 weeks, including pregnant or postpartum employees, parents of two or more children under 15 or a child with disabilities, employees with disabilities, employees whose wives are on maternity leave, employees hired after military service, and employees studying who want to use leave for exams or a thesis. Two weeks' notice is required before taking vacation leave.
expected_answer: The full 18 days after 50 weeks of continuous employment; before that a pro-rated vacation (some categories get the full leave earlier).

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: The minimum vacation increment is 4 hours. Vacation may be used in minimum 4-hour increments.
expected_answer: Vacation may be used in minimum 4-hour increments.

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: The handbook doesn't set a single minimum for all vacation. The main continuous part of your annual leave must be at least 14 calendar days. Any remaining part can be requested in minimum 3-day increments, or in minimum 1-day increments during martial law. Two weeks' notice is required before taking vacation leave, and the employer may decide how the leave is divided.
expected_answer: The main part must be at least 14 calendar days, the rest in minimum 3-day increments; during martial law vacation can be taken in 1-day increments.

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: In Costa Rica, the handbook does not set one minimum for any single block of vacation. Instead, the main continuous part of your annual leave must be at least 14 calendar days. Any remaining part of the leave can be requested in minimum 3-day increments. Two weeks' notice is required before taking vacation leave, and the employer may decline to split the leave as you wish.
expected_answer: The main part must be at least 14 calendar days, the rest in minimum 3-day increments (no martial-law exception).

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: It Company recognizes six holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day. Full-time employees receive one day's pay and part-time employees receive four hours' pay when a holiday falls on a regular workday, provided they are present on the last scheduled day before and the first scheduled day after the holiday.
expected_answer: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day.

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: The company observes six US holidays: New Year Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day. In addition, all employees get 5 floating holidays that they can use to celebrate Ukrainian public holidays at their discretion. Four days' notice is required before taking a paid holiday, and no more than one paid holiday can be taken in any 30-day period.
expected_answer: Six US holidays (New Year, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) plus 5 floating days for Ukrainian public holidays.

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: For Costa Rica employees, It Company observes these six public holidays: New Year's Day (January 1), Juan Santamaría Day (April 11), Labour Day (May 1), Guanacaste Day (July 25), Independence Day (September 15), and Christmas Day (December 25). If a holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, it is observed the following Monday. Employees also get 7 floating holidays they can use for any other public or personal holiday, with 4 days' notice and no more than 1 paid holiday off in any 30-day period.
expected_answer: New Year's Day, Juan Santamaría Day, Labour Day, Guanacaste Day, Independence Day (September 15), Christmas Day.

question: How many floating holidays do I get?
answer: I don't have information about floating holidays in the handbook. It lists fixed paid holidays (New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day), but it does not mention floating holidays. Please contact HR for details.
expected_answer: Not covered by the handbook; the bot should say it does not know and refer to HR.

question: How many floating holidays do I get?
answer: You get 5 (five) additional floating holidays, which you can use to celebrate any Ukrainian public holidays at your discretion. Note: no more than 1 paid holiday day off can be taken in a 30-day period, and 4 days' notice is required before taking a paid holiday/day off.
expected_answer: 5 floating holidays for Ukrainian public holidays; no more than 1 per 30 days, 4 days' notice.

question: How many floating holidays do I get?
answer: You get 7 (seven) additional floating holidays, which you can use to celebrate any public or personal holiday at your discretion. These apply to Costa Rica employees. No more than 1 paid holiday day off can be taken in a 30-day period, and 4 days' notice is required before taking a paid holiday or day off.
expected_answer: 7 floating holidays; no more than 1 per 30 days, 4 days' notice.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: For employees who work in New York City, paid safe and sick time is paid at the same rate the employee earns at the time they use it, but never less than the applicable minimum wage. Payment is made no later than the payday for the next regular payroll period after the time was used. Paid safe and sick time does not count as hours worked for overtime calculations. Employees receive a grant of 40 hours at the start of employment and at the start of each calendar year, and unused time does not carry over or get paid out at separation. Other employees are not covered by this policy in the handbook excerpts provided, so please contact HR if you have questions about your location.
expected_answer: Employees working in New York City get 40 hours of paid safe and sick time per calendar year, paid at their regular rate; longer off-the-job illness — statutory short-term disability, 50% of average wages up to $170 a week from the 8th day.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: Employees are entitled to up to four (4) months of paid sick leave for illness or injury, provided it is confirmed by a sick leave certificate from a medical institution. The employer pays the first five days of sick leave, and the Social Insurance Fund pays the rest. The Fund's payment depends on seniority: under 6 months of employment, it is based on minimum wage; 0-3 years, 50% of average salary; 3-5 years, 60%; 5-8 years, 70%; and 8+ years, 100%.
expected_answer: Up to 4 months with a medical certificate; the first 5 days are paid by the employer, the rest by the Social Insurance Fund at 50–100% of average salary depending on seniority.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: Sick leave is paid for up to four months if the illness or injury is confirmed by a medical certificate (from the CCSS or another medical institution). For the first three days, the employer pays 50% of your salary. From the fourth day, the CCSS pays 60% of your average salary. This applies to employees in Costa Rica.
expected_answer: For the first 3 days the employer pays 50% of salary; from the 4th day the CCSS pays 60% of average salary.

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: У довіднику немає окремого розділу про декретну відпустку, але є два пов'язаних положення для співробітників у Нью-Йорку (США). 1) Тимчасова непрацездатність (Statutory Short-Term Disability): вагітність покривається, тривалість 6 тижнів після пологів або 8 тижнів після кесаревого розтину. Виплата становить 50% середньої зарплати за останні 8 тижнів, але не більше 170 доларів на тиждень. Перші 7 днів не оплачуються. Заяву (форма DB-450) потрібно подати протягом 30 днів після початку непрацездатності. 2) Оплачувана відпустка по догляду за дитиною (PFL): до 12 тижнів на 52-тижневий період, виплата 67% середньої зарплати, але не більше 67% середньої зарплати по штату. Її можна взяти, щоб доглядати за дитиною протягом перших 12 місяців після народження. Сама вагітність і пологи з PFL не покриваються. Ці виплати не можна отримувати одночасно, а разом вони не можуть перевищувати 26 тижнів.
expected_answer: Statutory short-term disability: 6 тижнів після звичайних пологів (8 — після кесаревого), 50% середньої зарплати, до $170 на тиждень; плюс до 12 тижнів Paid Family Leave для догляду за дитиною (67% зарплати).

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: Декретна відпустка в Україні триває 126 календарних днів: 70 днів до очікуваної дати пологів і 56 днів після пологів. Вона оплачується в розмірі 100% середньої зарплати, яку компенсує Фонд соціального страхування.
expected_answer: 126 календарних днів (70 до пологів і 56 після), 100% середньої зарплати від Фонду соціального страхування.

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: Декретна відпустка в Коста-Риці триває 4 місяці: 1 місяць до очікуваної дати пологів і 3 місяці після пологів. Вона оплачується в розмірі 100% зарплати: 50% сплачує роботодавець, 50% сплачує CCSS (Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social).
expected_answer: 4 місяці: 1 до пологів і 3 після; 100% зарплати — 50% платить роботодавець і 50% CCSS.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?
answer: The handbook has no separate paternity leave policy with a set number of days. The closest policy is State Paid Family Leave (PFL) in the USA: eligible employees can take up to 12 weeks within any 52-consecutive-week period to bond with a new child during the first 12 months after birth, adoption, or foster placement. It is partially paid: 67% of the average weekly wage, up to 67% of the state average weekly wage. It is funded by employee payroll contributions. Eligibility requires a regular schedule of 20+ hours a week and 26 consecutive weeks of employment before leave starts (or, under 20 hours a week, 175 days worked). You must give 30 days' advance notice when the event is foreseeable and submit form PFL-1 to HR. The handbook does not state the policy by gender, so it should apply to fathers as well, but please confirm with HR.
expected_answer: No separate paternity leave; Paid Family Leave gives up to 12 weeks to bond with a child, paid at 67% of the average weekly wage.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?
answer: Fathers are entitled to two weeks (14 days) of unpaid leave for the birth of a child. Fathers can also take leave from the mother's maternity leave if she has already returned to work, which requires a request to the Head of Representative Office and supporting documents.
expected_answer: 2 weeks of unpaid leave; a father can also take over the mother's maternity leave if she has returned to work.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?
answer: Fathers in Costa Rica get eight (8) days of paid leave for the birth of a child. Fathers may also take leave from the mother's maternity leave if she has already returned to work, which requires a request to the Head of Representative Office and supporting documents.
expected_answer: 8 days of paid leave; a father can also take over the mother's maternity leave if she has returned to work.

question: Do I get a 13th-month salary?
answer: Yes. According to the handbook, employees in Costa Rica receive an annual 13th-month salary (aguinaldo) equal to one twelfth of the total salary earned from December 1 of the previous year to November 30 of the current year. It is paid no later than December 20.
expected_answer: Yes — the aguinaldo, one twelfth of the salary earned from December 1 to November 30, paid no later than December 20.

answer: It Company is normally open for business from 8:00 am to 6:00 pm, Monday through Friday. Employees are assigned a work schedule and are expected to begin and end work according to it.
expected_answer: 8.00 am to 6.00 pm, Monday through Friday.
